after_learn.summary: Synchronous dependency blocked the heartbeat during direct fetch.
after_learn.body: Observed at the catalog async boundary: direct synchronous fetch prevented the heartbeat from progressing while pending. Dispatch synchronous work to a worker so other work can progress. This workaround concerns the dependency used in that observation.
The catalog experiment records heartbeat progress during a pending synchronous fetch. Inspect this scheduling experience at an async boundary.

after_revise.summary: Correction: native_async fetch yields without worker dispatch.
after_revise.body: The search dependency now exposes a native_async API that yields while pending. Run native_async fetch directly and retain worker dispatch only for synchronous dependencies, including old components. The synchronous observation remains valid; applying its workaround to native async adds unnecessary dispatch.
